newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures rise in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures rise in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were higher across the board on Wednesday, encouraged by the yen's fall against the dollar and stronger overseas markets, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.7 yen per kg higher than the day's close. The benchmark July contract was up 0.7 yen at 151.1 yen. Volume was 13,867 lots.

"Private investors, who stayed out of the market in recent months, were coming back, supported by a perception that prices in producing countries are set to rise ahead of a seasonal fall in rubber output in mid-February," one trader said.
